base_member_text: M(:,icount)=getframe(gcf) (L23) stores frame structs in a matrix column -- works only in legacy MATLAB where getframe returned a struct assignable this way; movie export path is commented (L26) so M is otherwise unused.

fdir is a hard-coded personal path (L4); snapshot numbering uses 4-digit names unlike the 5-digit names in B_01_diagnose.m -- output-naming convention differs per run configuration, not resolvable here.

audit_member_text: Portability/interface defect: fdir is a hard-coded absolute path under one user's home directory on line 4, with no prompt, argument, or existence check; the script fails on installations without that exact directory.

The loop loads both eta and mask files on lines 15-16 without existence or parse checks, and line 17 assumes mask is logically index-compatible with ele; mismatched element counts/shapes or missing snapshots cause runtime failure.

nstart and nend from eval-style input on lines 5-6 are not validated as finite integer snapshot numbers. A descending range performs no iterations, while noninteger values produce formatted names rounded by %.4d that may not correspond to requested snapshots.
The only persistent-output call, movie2avi, is commented on line 26, so the active script leaves frames only in workspace variable M and does not write the advertised movie artifact.
